title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Senior Analyst, Marketing Science

London | Hybrid (3 days in office) | £60,000 - £75,000

This is an excellent opportunity for a Senior Analyst to join a leading customer experience and marketing consultancy where data plays a central role in shaping customer engagement and business strategy. You will work across a variety of analytics projects, partnering with well-known brands to deliver meaningful insights and measurable commercial outcomes.

The Company

They are a specialist consultancy focused on helping organisations better understand their customers through data, analytics, and marketing science. Their analytics function combines customer insight, digital analytics, measurement, and data strategy to support smarter decision-making. The team operates in a collaborative, project-based environment and offers strong opportunities for professional development and internal mobility.

The Role

  • Deliver campaign performance analysis and marketing effectiveness reporting
  • Generate actionable insights from customer, web, and digital data
  • Analyse customer journeys to identify opportunities for optimisation
  • Use analytics platforms such as GA4 and similar tools to answer business questions
  • Build, maintain, and enhance reporting solutions and dashboards
  • Support tagging, tracking, and data collection initiatives alongside technical teams
  • Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders and clients
  • Contribute to analytics roadmaps and wider account growth initiatives
  • Mentor junior analysts and support delivery across projects
  • Collaborate with strategy, technology, and data teams in an agile environment

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience in marketing analytics, digital analytics, or customer analytics within an agency or consultancy environment
  • Proficiency in SQL and/or Python
  • Experience with analytics platforms such as GA4, Adobe Analytics, Sprinklr, or similar tools
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations
  • Experience building reports, dashboards, and visualisations for stakeholders
  • Knowledge of campaign measurement, customer journey analysis, and marketing performance
  • Strong stakeholder management and client-facing communication skills
  • Experience supporting or guiding more junior analysts
  • Understanding of data governance, privacy regulations, and responsible data use

What They Offer

  • Salary of £60,000 - £75,000
  • Hybrid working model
  • Exposure to a broad range of analytics, customer insight, and marketing science projects
  • Opportunities to work across different client accounts and specialisms
  • Clear progression opportunities and ongoing professional development
  • Collaborative culture with opportunities to mentor and develop others
  • Exposure to emerging analytics capabilities, including AI-driven insight projects

How to Apply

If you are interested feel free to apply below.
